visual_tone: posh contemporary Indian home: marble or stone countertops, warm brass accents, curated furniture, soft natural light — lifestyle editorial, not mystical set design
camera_style: stable for A-roll; for B-roll use quick push-ins, handheld tracking, and over-shoulder shots inside upscale Indian homes
mood: intimate, hopeful, gently confronting unhealed patterns without being harsh
color_palette: warm ivory walls, teak and walnut wood, soft gold accents, natural daylight, muted linen textiles
avoid: no astrology symbols, zodiac wheels, birth charts, constellation overlays, glowing mystical props, harsh lighting, text overlays, logos, stock-photo feel, generic Western suburban kitsch unless the spoken line explicitly names a chart or sky symbol
format: vertical 9:16, must look like real video not a photograph, continuous but not floaty motion throughout
broll_casting: Indian family, same look across cutaways: parent mid-30s and child about 5–8 years old, polished casual / elevated everyday Indian fashion (linen, soft neutrals, light jewellery on parent), filmed in a posh modern Indian apartment or villa interior (designer kitchen island, living room with art and plants), natural skin tones, no celebrity faces
filler_clip: Soft morning light across a designer kitchen island with ceramic cups and fresh flowers in a posh Indian apartment. Camera: gentle overhead push-in. Marble texture, no people, no text, no astrology props.
